intro: To point out where you are going, в or на usually go with accusative: в музей, в город, на работу.

texto: To point out where you are going, в or на usually go with accusative: в музей, в город, на работу.
Compare the pair: где? в музее; куда? в музей. The change of case helps to distinguish location and destination.
